rows.grounds: compound umā+kānta, epithet identifying the deity

items.question: Which specific attributes of the deity warrant repeated obeisance in this invocation?
premises: Obeisance is expressed twice in this verse.
The recipient is characterized as holding a trident.
The recipient is identified as the beloved of Umā.
items.inference: Repeated reverential salutation is directed to the trident-bearing beloved of Umā.
items.plain_english: Obeisance, indeed obeisance, to the trident-handed beloved of Umā.
